purpose: Explicit formula scenarios for acquisition endpoints and final query reranking; not measured ablation improvements

assumptions.ranking: One adjacent positive/negative swap per changed query; other queries and ordering positions stay fixed
assumptions.reconstruction: Modify only patterns whose positive ranks are uniquely identified by all ten saved per-query metrics
assumptions.classification: Retain original pair scores, stage-cal mapping, probability outputs, threshold, confusion counts, losses and pair curves unchanged
assumptions.output_separation: Retrieval-only local reranking is a separate illustrative output. It is not ranking the same unchanged probability array, nor a learned deployable improvement
assumptions.temporal: Prior acquisition and Full/KD examples retained. MeanPool/StandardRank/AccountPool now also have mean R31/R32 +0.02; their previous R11/R22/R33 unchanged.
assumptions.scope: A deterministic formula scenario, no ideal-reference mixture or independent score distribution. Original experimental verdict unchanged

acquisition_shift.purpose: Hypothetical scalar MAP endpoints, not measured improvement or a claim that ablations have no effect
acquisition_shift.status: Historical intermediate scenario; current KD final endpoint shift is recorded in kd_final_reranking

kd_final_reranking.purpose: User-approved O/F anchors as a formula example, not measured KD improvement
kd_final_reranking.endpoint_rule: Keep R31/R33 fixed; increase mean R32 by 0.02 after the existing R11/R22 shifts
kd_final_reranking.pair_outputs: Original pair scores, calibration, threshold and all first 12 final metrics unchanged
kd_final_reranking.output_separation: Retrieval ranks are a separate illustrative output, not ranking unchanged pair probabilities

old_domain_reranking.purpose: User-requested +0.02 old-domain mean MAP for three ablations, explicit formula examples
old_domain_reranking.endpoint_rule: Increase each mean R31/R32 by 0.02; keep previous R11/R22/R33
old_domain_reranking.output_separation: Local query reranking is a separate illustrative retrieval output; original pair scores/probabilities unchanged
